description:
At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
 
 This position reports to: 
Operations Manager 
 __
 Your role and responsibilities 
 
 We are seeking an experienced and passionate .NET Application Development Engineer. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and delivering high-quality .NET solutions to support critical business operations. Your role will ensure the robustness of system architecture, the quality of code, and the efficient management of the entire lifecycle from requirements to deployment. 
 
The work model for the role is: {onsite} 

This role is contributing to the {PPMV LBU Management} in {Xiamen/Beijing China} . Main stakeholders are {ELDS} .

You will be mainly accountable for:
 Own End-to-End Development of Core Business Systems 
 Lead the software development, iterative optimization, and technical architecture upgrades for core business systems in manufacturing enterprises (including MES, SCM, QMS, IIoT, etc.). Ensure that the system architecture is deeply aligned with production and operational scenarios to support efficient business execution.
 Participating in Business Requirements Analysis and Technical Solution Design 
 Actively engage in business requirements gathering and analysis. Based on a thorough understanding of key manufacturing processes, translate complex business needs into feasible, efficient, and scalable technical solutions, and take implementation.
 Responsible for Core Technical Implementation and Quality Assurance 
 Lead the coding, unit testing, and system integration debugging of core functional modules. Address key technical challenges and performance bottlenecks during development. Take full responsibility for system stability, security, and high performance to ensure reliable operation in production environments.
 Responsible for System Operations, Support, and Continuous Optimization 
 Oversee post-deployment operational monitoring, performance tuning, and rapid response to production issues. Ensure the continuity, high availability, and exceptional user experience of mission-critical business systems.
 Drive Innovation in Advanced Technologies and Smart Manufacturing Integration 
 Actively promote technological innovation by exploring and implementing AI technologies (such as machine learning, computer vision, and intelligent decision optimization) in smart manufacturing scenarios. Applications include intelligent quality inspection, production scheduling prediction, and equipment predictive maintenance, leveraging technology to continuously enhance production efficiency and intelligence.
 ​
 Our team dynamics 
You will join a {dynamic, talented, high performing} team, where you will be able to thrive.
 

 Qualifications for the role 
 Basic Qualifications: 
 Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
 around 3 years of .NET full-stack development experience (with proficiency in C#, .NET Core/.NET 5+, ASP.NET MVC/Web API).
 Core Technical Competencies: 
 Back-end & Architecture: 
 Mastery of object-oriented design and common architectural patterns (e.g., MVC, Microservices), with familiarity in Entity Framework Core, dependency injection, multi-threading, and asynchronous programming
 Front-end Technology: 
 Experience with at least one mainstream front-end framework (e.g., Vue.js, Angular, React).
 Database: 
 Proficiency in SQL Server or MySQL development and performance optimization.
 Cloud & Infrastructure: 
 Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure (or other major cloud platforms), and knowledge of containerization technologies (e.g., Docker), system deployment, monitoring, and permissions management.
 Familiarity with Agile development methodologies such as Scrum

 More about us 
 ABB is a technology-based provider of power and automation products, systems, solutions and services. Building on our core strengths of technology leadership, pioneering spirit and a sustainable approach to business, ABB helps our customers to become more profitable while lowering environment impact.

 
 Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.
 
 Ready to make an impact? 
 
 Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.
